name: Accomplished Prodigy
body:
You have mastered multiple professions.

Prerequisites: 1 or more ranks in at least two professions.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to all Profession skills. If you have at least 10 ranks in a particular profession you gain a +4 bonus for that skill.
